questions.stem: I ______ my homework two hours ago. It was easy.
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时与一般过去时的区别。句中的'two hours ago'（两小时前）是明确的过去时间状语，只能与一般过去时连用。现在完成时（have finished）不能与具体的过去时间状语（如ago, yesterday, last week等）连用。因此选B。解题技巧：看到'ago'就选一般过去时。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book ______ I borrowed from the library yesterday is very interesting.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系词的选择。先行词'the book'是物，在定语从句中作宾语，因此用which或that。who/whom用于先行词是人时，whose表示所属关系。因此选B。解题技巧：先行词是物用which/that，是人用who/whom。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These trees ______ by the students last spring. Now they are growing well.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般过去时的被动语态。时间状语'last spring'表明是过去时，主语'trees'与动词'plant'是被动关系（树被种植），因此用一般过去时的被动语态was/were + 过去分词。主语是复数，用were planted。因此选B。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Excuse me, could you tell me ______?
—Sure. It's next to the post office.
questions.explanation: 本题考查宾语从句的语序和时态。宾语从句必须使用陈述语序（主语+谓语），排除A和C。主句'could you tell me'中的could表示委婉请求，不是过去时，因此从句根据实际情况用一般现在时。因此选B。解题技巧：宾语从句用陈述语序，注意时态呼应。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: We should ______ the environment by saving water and reducing waste.
questions.explanation: 本题考查语境中的词义辨析。根据后半句'saving water and reducing waste'（节约用水和减少浪费）可知这是保护环境的行为。protect意为'保护'，pollute意为'污染'，destroy意为'破坏'，damage意为'损害'。因此选A。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。空格处修饰名词'news'，需要形容词。wonder是名词/动词，wonderful是形容词（精彩的），wonderfully是副词，wondering是现在分词。因此选A。后缀-ful通常构成形容词，表示'充满...的'。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: Please ______ the lights when you leave the classroom to save electricity.
questions.explanation: 本题考查短语动词辨析。turn on打开，turn off关闭，turn up调大（音量），turn down调小/拒绝。根据'leave the classroom'和'save electricity'可知应该关灯。因此选B。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 本题考查固定搭配'take part in'（参加）。give part in无此搭配，play后通常接球类运动，join后直接加组织/人。因此选B。

Last week, our school organized an environmental protection activity. All the students were asked to (8)______ part in it. The activity aimed to teach us how to live a green life and protect our planet.

On Monday morning, we attended a lecture given by a scientist. He told us that our planet is facing serious (9)______. For example, many animals are losing their homes because of pollution and climate change. We also learned that even small actions can make a big (10)______ to the environment.

After the lecture, we started a recycling project in our classroom. We collected plastic bottles and waste paper. At first, some students thought it was (11)______ and didn't want to join. But when they saw how much waste we could reuse, they changed their minds and became very active.

By the end of the week, we had collected over 200 kilograms of recyclable materials. Our teacher said we (12)______ a great job. This activity helped us understand the importance of protecting our environment for future generations.

questions.explanation: 本题考查语境推理。根据下文'For example, many animals are losing their homes because of pollution'（例如，许多动物因污染失去家园）可知，这里讲的是地球面临的'问题'。problems意为'问题'，符合语境。因此选B。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what can a solar backpack do?
options: A. It can store more books than normal bags.
B. It can connect to the internet anywhere.
C. It can charge devices using sunlight.
D. It can keep food and drinks cold.
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据文章第一段'They are special bags that can charge your electronic devices using sunlight'和第三段'You can then use this energy to charge your mobile phone...'可知，太阳能背包可以利用阳光给电子设备充电。因此选C。A、B、D在文中均未提及。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Have you ever heard of "solar backpacks"? They are special bags that can charge your electronic devices using sunlight. This green invention is becoming increasingly popular among students who love outdoor activities.

The backpack looks similar to a normal school bag, but it has a thin solar panel attached to the back. When you walk under the sun, the panel collects solar energy and stores it in a small battery inside the bag. You can then use this energy to charge your mobile phone, tablet, or other USB devices whenever needed.

Tom, a 14-year-old student from Shenzhen, bought one last month. "I often go hiking with my friends on weekends," he explained. "Before, I always worried about my phone running out of battery in the middle of nowhere. But now, as long as there is sunshine, I can keep my devices charged all day long."

However, experts remind us that these backpacks also have limitations. They don't work well on cloudy days or when you're walking in the shade. Also, they are more expensive than regular backpacks, usually costing between 300 to 500 yuan.

Despite these drawbacks, many students still want to own one. They believe that using solar energy is an excellent way to reduce carbon emissions and protect the environment. "Every small step counts," said Tom. "If more people choose green products like this, we can definitely make our planet a better place to live."

questions.stem: Why did Tom buy the solar backpack?
options: A. Because it was cheaper than other bags.
B. Because he needed it for his hiking trips.
C. Because he wanted to show off to his friends.
D. Because it looked more fashionable.
questions.explanation: 推理判断题。根据第三段Tom的话'I often go hiking with my friends on weekends... Before, I always worried about my phone running out of battery... But now... I can keep my devices charged'可知，Tom购买这个背包是因为他周末经常徒步旅行，需要解决手机没电的问题。因此选B。A与文中'more expensive'矛盾，C和D文中未提及。

Having a good daily routine is essential for middle school students. It helps us stay healthy, improve our study efficiency, and maintain a positive mood. Here are some practical tips for organizing your day better.

(17)______. Try to wake up at the same time every morning, even on weekends. This regular schedule helps your biological clock work properly. Avoid staying up late playing computer games or watching videos, as lack of sleep affects your concentration.
